review_note: First draft from reading the repo; not yet confirmed by the project owner. Results only count once human_reviewed is true.

must_mention_risks.text: AWS IoT (Thing and IoT rule) has no Google Cloud equivalent (Cloud IoT Core was retired); device ingestion needs a different design such as an MQTT broker or Pub/Sub
SNS subscription fan-out to three SQS queues with filtering must be re-expressed as Pub/Sub subscriptions and filters
SQS dead-letter queues and queue policies must be rebuilt as Pub/Sub dead-letter topics and IAM bindings
DynamoDB table access patterns must be reviewed for Firestore or Bigtable
